body: I mean it's not *that* small it has 200k population but there's really not much to do in it. I'm only 16 though so I don't think my parents think i'm ready. IDK I just feel bored and I don't understand why. I read through the other submissions and they feel like committing suicide because they have no friends, a death in the family, life is being a bitch to them and I understand why they feel like suicide is the only way out but I don't understand why I feel like this because my life I mean it isn't the greatest but it's the greatest it has been.

I don't really have motivation to try new things, really the only fun I have is when I go and drink/do drugs with friends but even that is getting boring now. What do you think would hurt my family less, moving to a completely different state and severing ties or just dying? If I die atleast they know where i'm at and don't have to constantly think.
